Thanks — quick clarifications from procurement/security so we can scope the intake properly: 

1) SOC 2: we need the latest SOC 2 Type II report (or a company-attested summary and the auditor firm). A short SOC 2 summary + auditor name is fine for initial review.
2) HIPAA: confirm whether Redwood will sign a BAA for this deployment and whether any PHI will be logged or stored.
3) SSO: we need SAML metadata and confirmation that you support IdP-initiated and SP-initiated SSO.
4) SCIM: confirm supported SCIM endpoints (v2 preferred) and whether group sync is supported.
5) RBAC: a short admin roles matrix (who can elevate, who can see logs) would be helpful.

Procurement timeline: we're aiming to complete vendor reviews by 11/18. If you can get those items to us today or tomorrow that would be ideal.

Also attaching our standard vendor security questionnaire (VSA) — please ignore the attachment stub here, procurement will upload the actual doc to our portal; we'll accept links or PDFs.

Thanks for the list — please see our responses and attachments below.

SOC 2
- Attached: Redwood_SOC2_Type_II_2025_summary.pdf (one-page summary + auditor: Waverly Audit Partners). The full Type II report is available under NDA; we can start with the summary and provide the report to your security/legal team.

HIPAA / BAA
- Redwood will sign a BAA. We do not persist PHI in model training datasets; customer-configured retention and optional redaction are available. Application logs retain 30 days by default; extended retention can be contracted.

SSO / SAML
- Attached: redwood_sso_metadata.xml (SAML 2.0 metadata). We support both IdP-initiated and SP-initiated SSO, SAML POST binding for ACS, and SingleLogout via HTTP-Redirect.

SCIM
- Attached: scim_api_quickstart.pdf. We support SCIM v2 for Users (/scim/v2/Users) and Groups (/scim/v2/Groups), including PATCH, PUT, GET, and DELETE. Group sync and externalId mapping are supported. We also provide a managed SCIM connector for customers who want Redwood to handle provisioning.

RBAC
- Attached: rbac_admin_controls_matrix.xlsx (roles & privileges). High-level: org_admin (full), support_admin (support-level, masked data), read_only_admin (view logs/metrics).

Next steps
- If this looks complete, please confirm whether procurement needs a copy of the full SOC 2 report under NDA and if you want our legal team to send a BAA draft.
- If handy, can we schedule a 30-minute intake call on 11/12 or 11/13 to walk your security team through the materials?

Best,
Monica Patel
